item.title: Feature request: Native integration with Atomic Chat (local OpenAI-compatible LLM provider)
item.body:
## Summary

We would like **first-class integration** between [Trae IDE](https://www.trae.ai/) and **[Atomic Chat](https://github.com/AtomicBot-ai/Atomic-Chat)** — an open-source, privacy-focused desktop app for running local LLMs offline.

Atomic Chat already exposes an **OpenAI-compatible local API** that other tools can use. Trae users who run models locally via Atomic Chat should be able to select it as easily as built-in presets (Ollama, OpenRouter, etc.), without fragile manual URL configuration.

## About Atomic Chat

- **Project:** https://github.com/AtomicBot-ai/Atomic-Chat
- **Website:** https://atomic.chat/
- **License:** Apache 2.0
- **Local API (default):** `http://127.0.0.1:1337/v1/chat/completions`
- **Model discovery:** `GET /v1/models` (OpenAI-compatible)
- **Platforms:** macOS (Apple Silicon) today; Windows planned
- **Use case:** Download and run HuggingFace models (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, etc.) fully offline; optional cloud providers; MCP support for agent workflows

Atomic Chat is already consumed by other AI coding stacks via the same OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. OpenWork / opencode with provider id `atomic-chat`).

## Problem today in Trae

Trae supports **Custom Model** entries, but local Atomic Chat integration is awkward:

1. **No dedicated provider preset** — unlike Ollama/OpenRouter, users must manually add a custom OpenAI entry.
2. **Custom Request URL must be the full path** (since v3.3.51 Trae does not auto-append `/chat/completions`) — easy to misconfigure.
3. **Related:** [#2076](https://github.com/Trae-AI/TRAE/issues/2076) — cannot override provider base URL in a uniform way; blocks many OpenAI-compatible local gateways.
4. **Builder / agent modes** need reliable **streaming** and **tool calling** against the local endpoint; behavior is untested/documented for Atomic Chat.

## Proposal

### Option A — Official provider preset (preferred)

Add **Atomic Chat** under **Settings → Models**, similar to Ollama:

| Field | Default |
|-------|---------|
| Provider name | Atomic Chat |
| Base URL | `http://127.0.0.1:1337` |
| API key | optional / `local` |
| Model list | fetched from `GET /v1/models` when server is reachable |

**UX details:**

- **Health check** on save: ping `/v1/models` or `/v1/chat/completions` and show clear error if Atomic Chat is not running.
- **Auto-discovery** (optional): detect `127.0.0.1:1337` when Atomic Chat starts.
- Document support for **Chat**, **Inline Chat**, and **Builder** with tool calls.

### Option B — Documented Custom Model path (minimal)

Until a native preset ships, publish official docs:

- Provider: **OpenAI**
- Custom Request URL: `http://127.0.0.1:1337/v1/chat/completions`
- Model ID: from Atomic Chat model list (e.g. user-selected GGUF)
- API key: any placeholder if not required

## API contract (for Trae implementers)

Atomic Chat’s local server targets **OpenAI Chat Completions** compatibility:

```http
POST http://127.0.0.1:1337/v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer <optional>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "<model-id>",
  "messages": [...],
  "stream": true,
  "tools": [...]   // required for Builder/agent
}
```

```http
GET http://127.0.0.1:1337/v1/models
```

We can provide a minimal test matrix (Chat / Builder / streaming / tools) from the Atomic Chat side if helpful.

## Benefits for Trae users

- **Privacy** — inference stays on device; aligns with Trae users asking for local LLMs ([#39](https://github.com/Trae-AI/TRAE/issues/39)).
- **Cost** — no per-token cloud billing for local models.
- **Ecosystem** — pairs Trae’s Builder/agent UX with Atomic Chat’s local inference + MCP story.

## Partnership / maintenance

We (Atomic Chat team) are happy to:

- Maintain Trae setup documentation in Atomic Chat repo
- Provide logos/copy for the provider preset
- Help test Builder tool-calling against our local API
- Coordinate on forum.trae.cn if GitHub Issues remain deprecated ([#2348](https://github.com/Trae-AI/TRAE/issues/2348))

## Related issues

- #39 — custom / local LLMs
- #2076 — custom base URL for providers

---

**Note:** We understand GitHub Issues may no longer be actively maintained per [#2348](https://github.com/Trae-AI/TRAE/issues/2348). We will cross-post this request to [forum.trae.cn](https://forum.trae.cn/c/7-category/7) as well. Please route to the product team if possible.
